theorem QOU.Hecke.MarkovBondLetter.tr_bond_letter {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] {i : ℕ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ avoiding T i) (hb : b ∈ avoiding T i) (c d : R) :
